candidate.definition_en: In a circular direction, towards the opposite direction, or to each person in a group.
candidate.explanation_ar: بشكل دائري، أو إلى الخلف (للاتجاه المعاكس)، أو بالمرور على الجميع (حول).

senses.definition_en: In a circle or with a circular movement.
senses.definition_ar: في مسار دائري أو حركة دورانية.
examples: The wheels went round and round.

senses.definition_en: So as to face in the opposite direction.
examples: Turn round and look at me.

senses.definition_en: To each person in a group or from one person to another.
senses.definition_ar: بالتوزيع على الجميع أو من شخص لآخر.
examples: Pass the papers round so everyone gets one.
Turn round and look at me.
Pass the papers round so everyone gets one.
The wheels went round and round.

translations.arabic_ar: حول في اتجاه دائري للخلف على الجميع
